source.title: Shrine of Cooperation
source.description: A panel at the base of the statue slides out, revealing a piece of parchment and a brilliant crystal similar to the one you discovered at Tyr's Hand.
source.objective: Deliver the crystal to Dietrich Praice in Orgrimmar.
source.completion:
Another shard of light! Where did you find this, <name>?

I agree with the author. If the shards can be used as a weapon against the living as well as the <race>, they could escalate the conflict between Alliance and Horde to a terrifying scale.
